main_text.p: bus, campanulis, (ridiculoLib.Sacr.Ceremon. more incantatis)fiducia collocetur, vt magicis quibusdam exorcizationibus, ab illis Dei creaturis arceatur Diabolus, quas nullus vnquam occupârat? Inibimus profecto cum Satana ipso fœdus, vbi Diabolicis hisce ἐθελοθρησκείαις viam sememel, aut veniam concesserimus: Profanum illud operis operati πεϱιέργου, ociosas peregrinarum precum submurmurationes, sacramentorum & numerum & virtutem, sacrilegam Eucharistiæ mutilationem; & mille alia cùm opinionum, tum ceremoniarum prodigia videns, prudensque

page.notes: Partly damaged at the upper left and edges. Greek words (ἐθελοθρησκείαις, περιέργου) are rendered from the scan and may be imprecise. The catchword "præ-" is a hyphenated line-end at the foot. The word "vt" in "vt magicis" is printed as "vt". The word "sememel" reads as printed, probably "semel" with a printing error.
